en.html:
...This was no longer a rice ball. It was only a lump of rice.

Not even a sphere. Big grains of salt stuck here and there. The squeeze had perhaps been too weak; the surface was already starting to fall apart.

And yet. Without any doubt, somebody had made this rice ball with all her might.

I took it in both hands and brought it to my mouth.

ja.html:
……それはもはや握り飯ではなかった。
　ただの米塊だった。

　球体とさえ言えない形状。
　ところどころに張り付いた塩の大粒。
　握る力が足りなかったのか、表面は崩れかけている。

　そして。
　間違いなく、必死につくられた握り飯。

　それを両手でつかんで、口へ運ぶ。
